scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @lms/shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @lms/api" "npm run dev --workspace @lms/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @lms/shared && npm run dev --workspace @lms/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @lms/shared && npm run dev --workspace @lms/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lms/shared && npm run build --workspace @lms/api && npm run build --workspace @lms/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @lms/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @lms/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @lms/web
